comment: I2L-OBS: the Lab observe roles' deployment inputs, NAMES only (values live in the operator's 0600 env files, never here). Read by tests/integration/lab_observe/test_i2l_obs.py and README.md. Every role is OFF until its env file exists; LAB-M1 enable needs P-08 (the staging window), P-09 (capture consent) and, for any live judge, P-10.

traces.pumps: the trace ship/retention/feedback pumps run in the consumer worker behind TRACE_PUMPS (composition WR-T-4, off by default); this role only measures them

traces.name: INFRX_IMAGE
traces.purpose: the release image the exporter runs in (a content-addressed id, as the gateway env)

traces.name: CLICKHOUSE_URL
traces.purpose: a read-only ClickHouse login for trace_envelopes / trace_deletions

traces.name: LAB_DATABASE_URL
traces.purpose: a read-only login on the transaction pooler (6543) for the feedback outbox lag

traces.name: TRACE_SPOOL_DIR
traces.purpose: the worker's spool directory, mounted read-only for its size

traces.name: S3_TRACE_BUCKET
traces.purpose: the trace content bucket (the pumps' grant below)

traces.name: S3_ENDPOINT_URL
traces.purpose: unset on AWS; a local S3-compatible endpoint otherwise

judge.name: LAB_DATABASE_URL
judge.purpose: the judge's own login on the transaction pooler: L2 grants, the D6J ledger

judge.name: JUDGE_LIVE_BUDGET_USD
judge.purpose: the live PROVIDER_USD cap; 0 until P-10

judge.name: JUDGE_PROVIDER_URL
judge.purpose: the judge endpoint; J2's adapter accepts loopback only until P-10

judge.name: CLICKHOUSE_URL
judge.purpose: read-only: the projection rows a judge job reads by durable request id

judge.name: S3_TRACE_BUCKET
judge.purpose: read-only content objects under the trace prefix

storage_grants.why: T2I writes content once; T3 sweeps delete it (the consumer worker's TRACE_PUMPS role)
J2 reads the consented request content it sends; never writes or deletes

judge.why: J2's HttpJudgeProvider refuses any other host; a live provider and its rates need P-10

traces.why: its own stores only; no third party
